Author: penguin4glte
Name: Auto Retainer Sell List
Description: Configure a list of items to maintain on sale at (lowest market price - 1 gil)
Changelog: Fixed an issue where items could be listed above the lowest market price. The lowest price is now taken from all received listings (instead of assuming the first listing is the cheapest), market data for a different item is ignored, and the lowest listing and calculated selling price are logged for diagnosis.
